pages.text: $(bold)How to obtain$():$(li)$(bold)Craftable$() base material - parts can be made directly at the Part Builder from bone-type ingredients, with no need to craft a material item first$(li)It can also be harvested from Ice and Fire's dragons (dragon bones dropped on kills, etc.)$(br2)Tier: $(bold)T1$().

$(bold)Innate traits$() (two):$(li)$(l:traits/trait_dragonbone)Carrier$(): boosts the level-based effects of dragonsteel traits by one level$(li)$(l:traits/trait_dragon_blood_tank)Dragon Blood Tank$(): stores the three kinds of dragon blood, for use with dragon blood infusion$(br2)Dragonbone is the easiest base material to come by - both of its traits revolve around dragon-themed gameplay.
